values.goal: Gate the v0.92 review tail on a complete, independently verified feature and critical-path evidence matrix.
values.required_outcome: Every indexed v0.92 feature and required critical path has exactly one evidence-bound accepted or blocking row; only a zero-blocker exact-head-reviewed gate may unlock WP-23 and later review work.
declared_scope: Canonical and legacy predecessor terminal reconciliation
Complete v0.92 feature and supporting-critical-path denominator
Exact implementation, review, merge, validation, integration, platform, and typed-terminal evidence
Quality matrix, gate record, blocker report, and exact-head review
authority_boundary: Canonical #311 is current WP-22 authority; legacy #5842 is immutable provenance
Canonical #310 must be terminal, reconciled, ancestral, and cleaned before execution binding
Each repository identity is verified independently and cross-repository substitution is forbidden
WP-22 evaluates evidence but does not repair product features or waive blockers
A blocking result does not unlock WP-23, WP-25, or release work
operator_constraints: Use typed C-SDLC v2 and an issue-bound FastWork worktree
Prepare while #310 runs but do not bind execution until #310 is terminal
No paid cloud or new platform execution
Use existing retained platform evidence only after provenance validation
Preserve clean primary main and unrelated worktrees
